sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Picture, for a minute, Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 请想象一下，洛杉矶。

sentences.en: The Grand Marquis downtown.
sentences.zh: 市中心的格兰德侯爵酒店。

sentences.en: The Spanish-style mansions in the hills.
sentences.zh: 山坡上的西班牙风格豪宅。

sentences.en: The Jetsons-like diners and drive-ins.
sentences.zh: 如杰特森一家般的餐厅和汽车餐厅。

sentences.en: Los Angeles is an architectural potpourri.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶是一个建筑的大熔炉。

sentences.en: It's the kind of place where if you want to go and build a house that looks like a Dutch colonial,
sentences.zh: 在这里，如果你想去建造一座看起来像荷兰殖民地风格的房子，

sentences.en: or a mansion with Doric columns, or a sleek modernist flat roof thing,
sentences.zh: 或者是一座带有多立克柱式的豪宅，又或者是一个圆滑的现代主义平屋顶建筑，

sentences.en: that's fine.
sentences.zh: 都没问题。

sentences.en: Anything goes.
sentences.zh: 百无禁忌。

sentences.en: That's Avery Truffleman.
sentences.zh: 说话的是艾弗里·特雷弗曼。

sentences.en: In Los Angeles, architecturally, there are no rules.
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶，从建筑学上讲，没有所谓的规则。

sentences.en: No unifying style.
sentences.zh: 也没有统一的风格。

sentences.en: Because for people flocking to Hollywood in the 1930s, 40s, and 50s,
sentences.zh: 因为对于在上世纪30、40和50年代蜂拥至好莱坞的人们来说，

sentences.en: the growing city gave them an opportunity to build whatever kind of house they wanted.
sentences.zh: 这座不断发展的城市为他们提供了一个机会，让他们可以建造自己想建的任何房子。

sentences.en: French chateau, futuristic modern, Italian villa, whatever.
sentences.zh: 法国城堡、未来主义现代风格、意大利别墅，随你便。

sentences.en: And there was this one particular architect who could do it all and do it well.
sentences.zh: 当时有这样一位杰出的建筑师，他什么都能设计，而且样样精通。

sentences.en: And his name was Paul Revere WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫保罗·里维尔·威廉姆斯。

sentences.en: Paul Williams' contribution to American architecture can be described in a number of different ways.
sentences.zh: 保罗·威廉姆斯对美国建筑的贡献可以从许多不同的方面来描述。

sentences.en: This is architect Phil Freelon.
sentences.zh: 这位是建筑师菲尔·弗里隆。

sentences.en: He was an incredibly gifted residential designer.
sentences.zh: 他是一位极具天赋的住宅设计师。

sentences.en: And on the West Coast, particularly in Los Angeles, he was known for designing residences of a number of Hollywood stars.
sentences.zh: 在西海岸，特别是在洛杉矶，他以设计众多好莱坞明星的住宅而闻名。

sentences.en: Paul Williams designed Frank Sinatra's bachelor pad, a mansion for Lucille Ball and Desi Arnaz.
sentences.zh: 保罗·威廉姆斯为弗兰克·辛纳屈设计了单身汉公寓，为露西尔·鲍尔和德西·阿纳兹设计了一座豪宅。

sentences.en: He made additions on the Beverly Hills Hotel and the Palm Springs Tennis Club.
sentences.zh: 他参与扩建了贝弗利山酒店和棕榈泉网球俱乐部。

sentences.en: He also helped design the stately and sparse L.A.
sentences.zh: 他还参与设计了庄严而简约的洛杉矶

sentences.en: County Courthouse.
sentences.zh: 县法院。

sentences.en: And if you've ever flown into LAX, you can see this really space-age-y looking structure,
sentences.zh: 如果你曾乘飞机抵达洛杉矶国际机场，你会看到这座极具太空时代感的建筑，

sentences.en: almost like a flying saucer with long legs that landed in front of Terminal 1.
sentences.zh: 它几乎就像一个长着长腿、降落在1号航站楼前的飞碟。

sentences.en: That's called the theme building.
sentences.zh: 那叫做主题航站楼。

sentences.en: And Paul Williams was part of the team that made that.
sentences.zh: 而保罗·威廉姆斯就是建造它的团队成员之一。

sentences.en: And the sheer volume of his work.
sentences.zh: 还有他那惊人的作品数量。

sentences.en: He produced over 3,000 projects in his career, in his 50-year career.
sentences.zh: 在他的职业生涯中，在他长达50年的职业生涯中，他参与设计了3000多个项目。

sentences.en: And that's quite an achievement.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个巨大的成就。

sentences.en: No one is exactly sure how many buildings he worked on.
sentences.zh: 没有人确切知道他究竟参与设计了多少栋建筑。

sentences.en: It's certainly in the thousands.
sentences.zh: 但肯定有数千栋之多。

sentences.en: But still, he was largely an invisible figure in architectural history, as well as Los Angeles' history.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他在建筑史以及洛杉矶的历史上，在很大程度上仍然是一个隐形人物。

sentences.en: He designed everything from mansions, luxury hotels, and car dealerships, to hospitals, housing projects, and public schools.
sentences.zh: 他设计的建筑包罗万象，从豪宅、豪华酒店、汽车经销店，到医院、保障房和公立学校。

sentences.en: In addition to the variety of Williams commissions, he could work in a huge variety of styles.
sentences.zh: 除了威廉姆斯接手的设计委托种类繁多之外，他还能够驾驭极其丰富的建筑风格。

sentences.en: Seriously, if you pick two of his buildings at random, in most cases, you'd never know that the same architect made them both.
sentences.zh: 说真的，如果你随机挑选他的两座建筑，在大多数情况下，你绝对猜不出这两座建筑出自同一位建筑师之手。

sentences.en: So he really didn't have a particular signature move or form or material usage that you could drive up and say,
sentences.zh: 所以他真的没有什么标志性的手法、特定造型或材料运用，让你一眼望去就能断定，

sentences.en: that's a Paul Williams building.
sentences.zh: 这是一座保罗·威廉姆斯的建筑。

sentences.en: But if you look at the body of work, there is a level of excellence and a consistency in the quality of the work,
sentences.zh: 但如果你审视他的整体作品，就会发现其中蕴含着高水准的卓越品质和一以贯之的质量，

sentences.en: not necessarily in a stylistic manner.
sentences.zh: 这并非体现在某种固定的风格上。

sentences.en: He is the architect who helped make the multi-style style of Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 他正是那个塑造了洛杉矶多元风格的建筑师。

sentences.en: And Los Angeles, in turn, helped make him.
sentences.zh: 而洛杉矶反过来也成就了他。

sentences.en: In Los Angeles, Paul Williams was able to build a career for himself that he probably couldn't have had anywhere else in America,
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶，保罗·威廉姆斯得以开创了一番职业生涯，这在当时的美国其他任何地方都是几乎不可能做到的，

sentences.en: as an African-American architect.
sentences.zh: 作为一个非裔美国人建筑师。

sentences.en: Paul Williams is an African-American architect who was much more than an African-American architect.
sentences.zh: 保罗·威廉姆斯是一位非裔美国人建筑师，但他远不止于一位非裔美国人建筑师。

sentences.en: He was simply one of the best architects of the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 他简直是20世纪最伟大的建筑师之一。

sentences.en: This is Karen Hudson, Paul Williams' biographer, and also his granddaughter.
sentences.zh: 这是卡伦·哈德逊，保罗·威廉姆斯的传记作家，也是他的孙女。

sentences.en: I was very close to him.
sentences.zh: 我跟他非常亲近。

sentences.en: I grew up a block away.
sentences.zh: 我从小就住在离他一个街区远的地方。

sentences.en: Hudson says the Los Angeles her grandfather grew up in, back in the early 1900s, was pretty different from what it is now.
sentences.zh: 哈德逊说，她的祖父在20世纪初成长时的洛杉矶，与现在的面貌大不相同。

sentences.en: I mean, it was open spaces.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当时到处都是开阔地。

sentences.en: He was born downtown, Ays and Santee.
sentences.zh: 他出生在市中心，在A街和桑蒂街交汇处。

sentences.en: You know, downtown was the heart of L.A.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，市中心曾是洛杉矶的心脏。

sentences.en: We're talking 1894.
sentences.zh: 我们说的是1894年。

sentences.en: And in 1894, when Williams was born, Los Angeles was pretty much a small downtown surrounded with bean fields and orange groves and the wild Pacific.
sentences.zh: 在1894年威廉姆斯出生时，洛杉矶基本上只是一个四周环绕着豆田、橘林和波涛汹涌的太平洋的小市中心。

sentences.en: And the population of L.A.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶的人口

sentences.en: was skyrocketing.
sentences.zh: 当时正在急剧飙升。

sentences.en: From 1890 to 1900, the city doubled from 50,000 to 100,000 residents in just 10 years.
sentences.zh: 从1890年到1900年，短短10年间，该市人口翻了一番，从5万人激增至10万居民。

sentences.en: The growing city was full of people that had come west for a better life.
sentences.zh: 这座不断扩张的城市挤满了为了寻找更好生活而来到西海岸的人们。

sentences.en: Paul Williams' parents were from Memphis and had moved to Los Angeles just before he was born.
sentences.zh: 保罗·威廉姆斯的父母来自孟菲斯，在他出生前不久搬到了洛杉矶。

sentences.en: They came to California for their health because they both had tuberculosis.
sentences.zh: 他们为了健康来到加州，因为两人都患有结核病。

sentences.en: And that's how he was orphaned before he was four.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，他在四岁不到时就成了孤儿。

sentences.en: Williams was raised by foster parents.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯是由寄养父母抚养长大的。

sentences.en: He had a brother who was nine years older than him who was raised in a different family and died at a young age of pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 他有一个比他大九岁的哥哥，在另一个家庭长大，但在很小的时候就死于肺炎。

sentences.en: Without much of a family of his own, Williams spent a lot of time in the neighborhood, in downtown L.A., which was full of immigrants from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏完整的原生家庭，威廉姆斯把大量时间花在了社区里，花在洛杉矶市中心，那里住满了来自世界各地的移民。

sentences.en: I mean, he talks about learning conservation and gardening and things from the Japanese kids in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他提到自己从社区的日本孩子那里学到了节约、园艺之类的事情。

sentences.en: And so he sort of soaked all that up.
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上把这些都吸收了进去。

sentences.en: And this diverse group of kids all went to school together, even though Paul Williams remembers being the only black kid.
sentences.zh: 这群背景各异的孩子都在同一所学校上学，尽管保罗·威廉姆斯记得自己是唯一的黑人小孩。

sentences.en: There were no segregated schools in L.A.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶没有实行种族隔离学校。

sentences.en: There weren't that many black kids, but they went segregated.
sentences.zh: 黑人小孩没那么多，但他们并没有被隔离。

sentences.en: This would be instrumental later in life, when his high school connections would prove very valuable in Paul Williams' career.
sentences.zh: 这对他后来的生活起到了关键作用，他高中时期的人脉在保罗·威廉姆斯的职业生涯中证明了其极高的价值。

sentences.en: It's hard to say exactly where Williams' desire to be an architect came from.
sentences.zh: 很难说威廉姆斯想成为一名建筑师的愿望究竟源自何处。

sentences.en: He did have a natural talent for drawing, and then somehow he learned that architecture was a profession, and then resolutely decided it was for him,
sentences.zh: 他确实有着绘画的天赋，后来不知怎么地他了解到建筑学是一门专业，于是坚决决定这就是他的志向所在，

sentences.en: which is kind of incredible when you think about it.
sentences.zh: 现在想来这真是有点不可思议。

sentences.en: He never knew another architect, never really even heard of another architect when he was young.
sentences.zh: 他年轻时从未认识过其他建筑师，甚至从未真正听说过其他建筑师。

sentences.en: When Williams told his high school guidance counselor that he wanted to practice architecture, he was told to give it up.
sentences.zh: 当威廉姆斯告诉他高中的升学顾问自己想从事建筑行业时，顾问劝他放弃。

sentences.en: He should not try to be an architect.
sentences.zh: 他不应该尝试成为一名建筑师。

sentences.en: He should be a doctor or a lawyer, because black people would always need doctors and lawyers.
sentences.zh: 他应该去当医生或律师，因为黑人永远需要医生和律师。

sentences.en: And white people would not hire him as an architect, and black people couldn't afford him.
sentences.zh: 而白人不会雇用他当建筑师，黑人又请不起他。

sentences.en: So he should just give up.
sentences.zh: 所以他还是放弃吧。

sentences.en: Didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Williams didn't go to architecture school.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯没有去读建筑学院。

sentences.en: Instead, he attended different art schools and engineering school, just cobbling together the skills he needed in drafting, landscaping, and materials,
sentences.zh: 相反，他上了不同的艺术学校和工程学校，东拼西凑地掌握了绘图、景观设计和材料学所需的技能，

sentences.en: before he was certified as a contractor in 1915.
sentences.zh: 并在1915年获得了承包商认证。

sentences.en: And then came the challenge of actually getting hired.
sentences.zh: 接下来面临的挑战是如何真正被录用。

sentences.en: In his own notes, he said he got dressed in his best suit, of which he probably only had one for church.
sentences.zh: 在他的个人笔记中，他提到自己穿上了最好的西装，那可能也是他仅有的一套去教堂穿的衣服。

sentences.en: But best suit, had his little briefcase, and he went knocking on doors.
sentences.zh: 穿着最好的西装，拿着他的小公文包，他开始挨家挨户敲门。

sentences.en: He approached all the architects in the area that he admired and showed them his portfolio.
sentences.zh: 他拜访了当地所有他钦佩的建筑师，并向他们展示了自己的作品集。

sentences.en: They all said no.
sentences.zh: 他们的回答全都是拒绝。

sentences.en: But if they smiled when they said no, then he went back the next day and kept knocking.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们拒绝时面带微笑，他第二天就会折返回去继续敲门。

sentences.en: And finally he got two offers.
sentences.zh: 最后他得到了两份录用通知。

sentences.en: One for $3 a week, maybe $5, and one for nothing.
sentences.zh: 一份一周3美元，也许是5美元，另一份则是零报酬。

sentences.en: But he took the job that was for nothing because he thought he would learn more and be in a better position to advance.
sentences.zh: 但他选择了零报酬的那份工作，因为他认为这样能学到更多东西，并处于更有利的发展地位。

sentences.en: And after the first week, they started paying him.
sentences.zh: 第一周过后，他们开始给他发薪水了。

sentences.en: Paul Williams worked for a landscape architect, a residential architect, and a commercial architect before he was licensed to practice in California in 1921.
sentences.zh: 在1921年获得加州执业资格之前，保罗·威廉姆斯曾为一名景观建筑师、一名住宅建筑师和一名商业建筑师工作过。

sentences.en: The following year, he started his own firm, Paul R.
sentences.zh: 第二年，他创办了自己的事务所，保罗·R·

sentences.en: Williams and Associates.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯联合事务所。

sentences.en: Williams' first solo commission was a house for a well-connected high school friend.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯独立接单的第一个项目是为一位背景深厚的高中朋友建造一栋房子。

sentences.en: And as neighborhoods in Los Angeles blossomed, word about Williams spread.
sentences.zh: 随着洛杉矶各个社区的繁荣兴旺，关于威廉姆斯的赞誉也随之传开。

sentences.en: In the 20s or early 30s, if you go to dinner at somebody's house because they have a new house, they say, who's your architect?
sentences.zh: 在20世纪20年代或30年代初，如果你去某人家里吃晚宴，因为他们刚买新房，大家就会问，你的建筑师是谁？

sentences.en: And then it's one more, one more, one more.
sentences.zh: 然后就会一个接一个地推荐下去。

sentences.en: Williams had an impeccable sense of scale, and he knew just how to situate a structure on a property to make best use of beautiful views and sunlight.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯对比例有着无可挑剔的感知力，他精准地知道如何在地产上安置建筑物，从而最大化地利用美丽的景观和阳光。

sentences.en: He helped create what would come to be known as the Hollywood style.
sentences.zh: 他参与打造了后来被称为“好莱坞风格”的建筑美学。

sentences.en: That opulent mixture of Mediterranean, European, and colonial influences.
sentences.zh: 那是地中海风格、欧洲风格和殖民地风格交织而成的奢华混搭。

sentences.en: With swimming pools and sweeping staircases.
sentences.zh: 配有游泳池和气派的旋转楼梯。

sentences.en: It's a rich and sumptuous sensibility.
sentences.zh: 这是一种富有而华丽的审美情趣。

sentences.en: But Paul Williams kept these mansions very clean and classy.
sentences.zh: 但保罗·威廉姆斯把这些豪宅设计得非常简洁高雅。

sentences.en: Paul R.
sentences.zh: 保罗·R·

sentences.en: Williams and Associates grew quickly and became renowned.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯联合事务所迅速发展壮大并声名远扬。

sentences.en: Although some clients would be taken aback when they met WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 尽管有些客户在见到威廉姆斯时会感到大吃一惊。

sentences.en: Because, you know, they may have read about him, you know, may have heard about him, but they didn't realize he was black.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，他们可能读过关于他的报道，也可能听说过他，但他们没想到他是黑人。

sentences.en: He didn't want people to be uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 他不想让人感到不自在。

sentences.en: And often they were.
sentences.zh: 而人们往往确实会感到不自在。

sentences.en: I mean, it's one thing to hire somebody.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，雇佣某人是一回事。

sentences.en: It's one thing to think that he's the best around and you want the best around.
sentences.zh: 认为他是周围最棒的并且你想要最好的又是另一回事。

sentences.en: It's another thing to actually touch him.
sentences.zh: 而真正与他进行肢体接触则是完全不同的情况。

sentences.en: Many of his white clients had never interacted with a black professional before.
sentences.zh: 他的许多白人客户此前从未与非裔专业人士打过交道。

sentences.en: Williams had to find ways to work around white people's discomfort with him.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯不得不寻找方法来避开白人面对他时的不适感。

sentences.en: He would not put people in a position where they felt like they had to shake his hand if they didn't want to.
sentences.zh: 他不会把对方置于一种如果他们不愿意就觉得非得跟他握手的境地。

sentences.en: So he would put his hands in his pockets or behind his back.
sentences.zh: 所以他会把双手插在口袋里或背在身后。

sentences.en: And Williams also recognized that many clients wouldn't want to take a seat next to him.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯还意识到，许多客户可能不想坐在他旁边。

sentences.en: And so to make them feel comfortable and to possibly persuade people who weren't sure about having this black man.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了让他们感到舒适，并可能说服那些对雇用这个黑人男子存有顾虑的人。

sentences.en: He could sit on one side of the desk, you'd be on the other side.
sentences.zh: 他可以坐在书桌的一侧，而你坐在另一侧。

sentences.en: And he would ask you, you know, do you want a formal living room?
sentences.zh: 他会问你，你需要一个正式的起居室吗？

sentences.en: Do you want a formal dining room?
sentences.zh: 你需要一个正式的餐厅吗？

sentences.en: Do you want a den because you have little kids?
sentences.zh: 因为你有小孩，所以需要一个起居室或家庭活动室吗？

sentences.en: Do you want this?
sentences.zh: 你需要这个吗？

sentences.en: Do you want that?
sentences.zh: 你需要那个吗？

sentences.en: And then, facing the client opposite the table, Paul Williams would sketch out a vision of the house upside down so that it faced the client.
sentences.zh: 然后，隔着桌子面对客户，保罗·威廉姆斯会倒着勾勒出房子的设计愿景，让图纸的方向正对客户。

sentences.en: And he would sketch it upside down.
sentences.zh: 他会倒着把图画出来。

sentences.en: It'd come alive before your eyes.
sentences.zh: 房子就在你的眼前活灵活现地呈现出来。

sentences.en: And I never interviewed anyone who saw him do it, who did not just light up as soon as we talked about it.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的所有看过他这样作画的人，只要我们谈起这个话题，无一例外都会双眼放光。

sentences.en: It was like, you should have seen him.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就像是，你真该看看他是怎么做的。

sentences.en: You've heard the expression, Ginger Rogers did everything Fred Astaire did except backwards and in high heels.
sentences.zh: 你听过这样一句话：金吉·罗杰斯完成了弗雷德·阿斯泰尔所做的一切，只是穿著高跟鞋且动作倒过来。

sentences.en: Well, Paul Williams did everything his white peers did except upside down and better.
sentences.zh: 嗯，保罗·威廉姆斯完成了他的白人同行所做的一切，只不过是倒着画，并且做得更好。

sentences.en: Williams was not the first architect to draw upside down.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯并不是第一个倒着画图的建筑师。

sentences.en: But it's indicative of the lengths he went to accommodate his white clients.
sentences.zh: 但这恰恰表明了他为了迁就白人客户而做出了多大的妥协。

sentences.en: He always dressed impeccably and worked tirelessly.
sentences.zh: 他总是衣着一丝不苟，工作废寝忘食。

sentences.en: He once wrote about a meeting with a potential client who warned Williams that he was also speaking with a number of other architects.
sentences.zh: 他曾在一篇关于与一位潜在客户会面的文章中写道，对方警告他说，自己同时也在和好几位其他建筑师接洽。

sentences.en: The potential client asked how soon Williams could submit preliminary drawings.
sentences.zh: 这位潜在客户问威廉姆斯多久能交出初步图纸。

sentences.en: Four o'clock tomorrow afternoon, said WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯说：“明天下午四点。”

sentences.en: The client thought it was impossible because all the other architects had asked for two or three weeks.
sentences.zh: 客户觉得这根本不可能，因为所有其他建筑师都要求两到三周时间。

sentences.en: And you can bet that, yes, Paul Williams delivered that plan at four o'clock the next day, as promised.
sentences.zh: 你可以确信，没错，保罗·威廉姆斯确实如承诺的那样，在第二天下午四点按时交出了设计图。

sentences.en: But he didn't tell the client that he had worked for 22 hours straight without eating or sleeping.
sentences.zh: 但他没有告诉客户的是，他已经连续工作了22个小时，不吃不喝。

sentences.en: He felt like he had to be light years better just to be accepted.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己必须比别人优秀千百倍，才能获得认可。

sentences.en: And, you know, often he wasn't accepted.
sentences.zh: 然而，你知道的，他常常并不能如愿得到认可。

sentences.en: Sometimes Williams was unwelcome in the very places he was designing.
sentences.zh: 有时威廉姆斯甚至会在自己设计的地方遭到冷遇。

sentences.en: And even after he had earned the respect of his clients,
sentences.zh: 甚至在他赢得客户的尊重之后，

sentences.en: he had to tolerate mistreatment from subcontractors and painters and plumbers.
sentences.zh: 他仍然不得不忍受分包商、油漆工和水管工的虐待。

sentences.en: You know, you hire him to do your home,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你请他来设计你的家，

sentences.en: and then some of the subpeople who are working on the home are like,
sentences.zh: 然后一些在家里工作的分包人员就会觉得，

sentences.en: I'm not taking orders from this black guy.
sentences.zh: 我才不听这个黑人的指挥。

sentences.en: It's a regular kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一种很常见的情况。

sentences.en: Throughout his career, even as he designed mansions for wealthy clients,
sentences.zh: 在他的职业生涯中，尽管他为富裕客户设计豪宅，

sentences.en: Williams also designed affordable homes for middle-class Angelenos.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯也为中产阶级的洛杉矶人设计经济适用房。

sentences.en: And he published books of inexpensive construction patterns
sentences.zh: 他还出版了廉价建筑图纸的书籍，

sentences.en: that anyone could use to build a home of their own.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以用这些来建造自己的家。

sentences.en: You could send in for $10 and get a floor plan for your house.
sentences.zh: 你只需寄去10美元就能得到一张房屋平面图。

sentences.en: Williams also worked on a number of projects specifically for black institutions,
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯还为许多专门的黑人机构做过项目，

sentences.en: including buildings on Howard University's campus in D.C.
sentences.zh: 包括位于华盛顿特区霍华德大学校园内的建筑，

sentences.en: and the 28th Street YMCA, which is in a historically black neighborhood in L.A.
sentences.zh: 以及位于洛杉矶历史悠久的黑人社区的第28街青年会（YMCA）。

sentences.en: The 28th Street Y was very important to him.
sentences.zh: 第28街青年会对他的意义非凡。

sentences.en: He put in the facade likenesses of Frederick Douglass and Booker D.
sentences.zh: 他在外墙上嵌入了弗雷德里克·道格拉斯和布克·T·

sentences.en: Washington
sentences.zh: 华盛顿的肖像，

sentences.en: because he believed that if young black boys could see that excellence every day as they walked in,
sentences.zh: 因为他相信，如果年轻的黑人男孩每天走进去时都能看到这种卓越，

sentences.en: it would make them a different kind of person.
sentences.zh: 这会让他们成为一个不同寻常的人。

sentences.en: He did a lot of charitable work.
sentences.zh: 他做了很多慈善工作。

sentences.en: He did lots of things for children, and not just in the African-American community.
sentences.zh: 他为儿童做了许多事情，不仅限于非裔美国人社区。

sentences.en: When he designed St. Jude's Research Hospital in Memphis, he did it completely free of charge.
sentences.zh: 当他在孟菲斯设计圣裘德研究医院时，他是完全免费的。

sentences.en: And he simply was one of the most prolific architects of his time, of any race.
sentences.zh: 而且他绝对是他那个时代、无论何种种族中最最多产的建筑师之一。

sentences.en: He produced thousands of projects in his 50-year career.
sentences.zh: 在他50年的职业生涯中，他完成了数千个项目。

sentences.en: He died in 1980, and his funeral was held in a church of his own design,
sentences.zh: 他在1980年逝世，他的葬礼在他自己设计的一座教堂里举行，

sentences.en: filled with friends, family, and past clients.
sentences.zh: 里面挤满了朋友、家人和过去的客户。

sentences.en: Paul R.
sentences.zh: 保罗·R·

sentences.en: Williams and associates continued working without him for a while.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯及其合伙人在他去世后继续工作了一段时间。

sentences.en: Well, after he died in 1980, the office went on for a couple of years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在他1980年去世后，事务所又维持了几年。

sentences.en: I'm not quite sure how long, but it essentially came to an end sometime by the end of the 80s.
sentences.zh: 我不确定具体多久，但基本上在80年代末之前的某个时候结束了。

sentences.en: This is Leslie Liebers of the University of Memphis.
sentences.zh: 这是孟菲斯大学的莱斯利·利伯斯。

sentences.en: And then all of the material from his practice was stored at a branch of the Broadway Federal Savings Banks.
sentences.zh: 然后他事务所的所有资料都被存放在百老汇联邦储蓄银行的一个分行里。

sentences.en: And this branch was a building Williams designed.
sentences.zh: 而这个分行就是威廉姆斯设计的一栋建筑。

sentences.en: He designed it, but the more important thing was that one of his daughters married the founder of Broadway Federal.
sentences.zh: 他设计了它，但更重要的是，他的一个女儿嫁给了百老汇联邦的创始人。

sentences.en: So it was essentially a family relationship.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上是一种家庭关系。

sentences.en: And most of Williams' documents and records were just there in the bank, stored in a room.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯的大部分文件和记录就存放在银行的一个房间里。

sentences.en: They weren't even in a vault.
sentences.zh: 它们甚至不在保险库里。

sentences.en: But then, in 1992, after a group of officers were acquitted of the brutal beating of Rodney King,
sentences.zh: 但是，在1992年，在一群警官因残酷殴打罗德尼·金而被无罪释放后，

sentences.en: the city of L.A.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶市

sentences.en: erupted into violent proteSt.
sentences.zh: 爆发了暴力抗议活动。

sentences.en: That branch of Broadway Federal burned to the ground, and everything in it burned to the ground.
sentences.zh: 百老汇联邦的那家分行被烧为平地，里面的一切都被烧成了灰烬。

sentences.en: And that was pretty much the end of everything available about Paul WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是关于保罗·威廉姆斯所有可用资料的终结。

sentences.en: This is where the Paul Williams Project comes in.
sentences.zh: 这就是保罗·威廉姆斯项目发挥作用的地方。

sentences.en: The Paul Williams Project is primarily a research project that seeks to accumulate information, photographs, etc.,
sentences.zh: 保罗·威廉姆斯项目主要是一个研究项目，旨在收集有关保罗·威廉姆斯的信息、照片等，

sentences.en: about Paul Williams, principally his career.
sentences.zh: 主要是他的职业生涯。

sentences.en: And a big part of this project was actually collecting information and hunting down which buildings were designed by WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 这个项目的一个重要部分实际上是收集信息并追查哪些建筑是威廉姆斯设计的。

sentences.en: The project, which is based at the University of Memphis,
sentences.zh: 该项目总部设在孟菲斯大学，

sentences.en: sent a photographic team to Los Angeles and Palm Springs and Las Vegas to start a catalog of Paul Williams' buildings.
sentences.zh: 派出一个摄影团队前往洛杉矶、棕榈泉和拉斯维加斯，开始编目保罗·威廉姆斯的建筑。

sentences.en: But they were not always easy to find.
sentences.zh: 但它们并不总是那么容易找到。

sentences.en: Because he was a master at period style.
sentences.zh: 因为他是精通各种历史风格的大师。

sentences.en: So, you know, he would have a Spanish-style house next to a colonial-style house next to a French-provincial-style house or a Gothic-style house.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他会把西班牙风格的房子建在殖民地风格的房子旁边，旁边又是法国普罗旺斯风格的房子或哥特式风格的房子。

sentences.en: You'd be like, okay.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得，好吧。

sentences.en: The project has found less than half of Williams' work.
sentences.zh: 该项目只找到了威廉姆斯不到一半的作品。

sentences.en: Who knows how many of his buildings have been unknowingly torn down or renovated beyond recognition.
sentences.zh: 谁知道有多少他的建筑在不知不觉中被拆除或翻新得面目全非。

sentences.en: And the Paul Williams Project is always hearing about more buildings to add to the catalog.
sentences.zh: 保罗·威廉姆斯项目总是能听到更多要加入目录的建筑。

sentences.en: Mostly in Los Angeles, but not exclusively.
sentences.zh: 主要在洛杉矶，但不仅限于此。

sentences.en: Williams' buildings are all over the country, and there are a few abroad.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯的建筑遍布全国，海外也有一些。

sentences.en: We discover them all the time.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在发现它们。

sentences.en: And then we verify.
sentences.zh: 然后我们进行核实。

sentences.en: We verify every house.
sentences.zh: 我们核实每一栋房子。

sentences.en: So we go to the city documents when pulling permits, all of that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在申请许可证时会查阅城市文件，诸如此类。

sentences.en: They're constantly checking and correcting themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们不断地核对和修正自己。

sentences.en: But it's really tough work because they have to go by accounts and records, which were mostly burned.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是一项艰巨的工作，因为他们必须依据账目和记录，而这些大多已被烧毁。

sentences.en: And then, you know, Williams' style is just all over the place.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，威廉姆斯的风格简直无所不包。

sentences.en: He just didn't stick to one thing.
sentences.zh: 他从不局限于某一种风格。

sentences.en: He was always learning and developing.
sentences.zh: 他一直在学习和发展。

sentences.en: And, of course, he would listen to his clients and try and respond to what they needed and what their desires were.
sentences.zh: 当然，他会倾听客户的意见，并试图满足他们的需求和愿望。

sentences.en: That's architect Phil Freelon again.
sentences.zh: 这是建筑师菲尔·弗里隆再次发言。

sentences.en: And I asked him if Williams had to be responsive to his clients and flexible in his style in order to survive as a black architect.
sentences.zh: 我问他，作为一名黑人建筑师，威廉姆斯是否为了生存而必须顺应客户并在风格上保持灵活性。

sentences.en: I think that Paul Williams' desire to satisfy his clients is something that many architects share.
sentences.zh: 我认为保罗·威廉姆斯满足客户的愿望是许多建筑师所共有的。

sentences.en: And it's not necessarily tied to race,
sentences.zh: 这不一定与种族挂钩，

sentences.en: although I will point out that he had to make certain adjustments in his approach to clients because of who he was and the time period in which he practiced.
sentences.zh: 尽管我要指出的是，由于他的身份以及他从业的时代背景，他不得不对对待客户的方法做出某些调整。

sentences.en: By the way, Phil Freelon is also a big deal.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，菲尔·弗里隆也是个大人物。

sentences.en: He worked on the Museum of the African Diaspora in San Francisco, the Center for Civil and Human Rights in Atlanta, and most recently.
sentences.zh: 他参与了旧金山非洲侨民博物馆、亚特兰大民权和人权中心的设计，最近还参与了

sentences.en: The National Museum of African American History and Culture on the Mall in Washington, D.C., where I was the architect of record.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿特区国家广场上的国家非裔美国人历史和文化博物馆，我是那里的注册建筑师。

sentences.en: Phil Freelon had already gotten into an architecture program before he had even heard of Paul WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 菲尔·弗里隆在听说保罗·威廉姆斯之前就已经进入了建筑专业。

sentences.en: I was maybe into my third or fourth year of school before I learned about Paul Williams, and that was really on my own.
sentences.zh: 我大约读书读到第三或第四年才知道保罗·威廉姆斯，而且这完全是靠我自己了解到的。

sentences.en: It wasn't anything in the curriculum or in architectural history that mentioned him.
sentences.zh: 课程大纲或建筑史中没有任何地方提到过他。

sentences.en: Let's make this clear.
sentences.zh: 让我们把这一点搞清楚。

sentences.en: There are a lot of black architects who get left out of the textbooks.
sentences.zh: 有很多黑人建筑师被排除在教科书之外。

sentences.en: Paul Williams was not the first black architect in America, but he was the first to be accepted as a member of the AIA, the American Institute of Architects.
sentences.zh: 保罗·威廉姆斯并不是美国的第一个黑人建筑师，但他是第一个被接纳为AIA（美国建筑师学会）会员的人。

sentences.en: The American Institute of Architects is the leading professional organization in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国建筑师学会是美国针对

sentences.en: for licensed architects and others in the profession.
sentences.zh: 执业建筑师和业内其他人士的领先专业组织。

sentences.en: Paul Williams joined the AIA in 1923.
sentences.zh: 保罗·威廉姆斯于1923年加入AIA。

sentences.en: And every black architect I know, they know who Paul Williams is.
sentences.zh: 我认识的每一个黑人建筑师都知道保罗·威廉姆斯是谁。

sentences.en: And I haven't met a white architect yet that knew who I was talking about if I were to mention that name.
sentences.zh: 但我还没遇到过哪个白人建筑师，在我提到这个名字时知道我在说谁。

sentences.en: And we need to change that.
sentences.zh: 我们需要改变这种状况。

sentences.en: And this is why Phil Freelon nominated Paul Williams for the AIA's highest individual award, the gold medal.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么菲尔·弗里隆提名保罗·威廉姆斯获得AIA最高个人奖项——金奖。

sentences.en: It's basically the award that welcomes an architect into the canon of all-time greats.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是将一位建筑师迎入历代伟大人物殿堂的奖项。

sentences.en: Previous winners include Frank Lloyd Wright, Mies van der Rohe, Le Corbusier, and Thomas Jefferson.
sentences.zh: 以前的获奖者包括弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特、密斯·凡·德·罗、勒·柯布西耶和托马斯·杰斐逊。
zh_words: 密斯·凡·德·罗、勒·柯布西耶

sentences.en: And now, Paul Williams will officially join their ranks, 37 years after his death.
sentences.zh: 现在，保罗·威廉姆斯在他去世37年后，将正式加入他们的行列。

sentences.en: This award means a lot to Freelon, and other African-American architects, in terms of general visibility.
sentences.zh: 对于弗里隆和其他非裔美国建筑师来说，这个奖项在提高整体知名度方面意义重大。

sentences.en: There are very few African-American architects working in this country, relatively speaking.
sentences.zh: 相对而言，在这个国家工作的非裔美国建筑师非常少。

sentences.en: You know, 2% of the licensed architects in this country are black.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这个国家的执业建筑师中只有2%是黑人。

sentences.en: And one of the ways you would want to combat that is to raise the visibility and to make sure people know that this is a great profession and that young people see it as a possibility and as an option for them.
sentences.zh: 你想解决这个问题的方法之一，就是提高知名度，确保人们知道这是一份伟大的职业，让年轻人将其视为一种可能性和选择。

sentences.en: And ultimately, this award is about recognizing a master, a recognition that is long overdue.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这个奖项是为了表彰一位大师，这是一项早就该给予的认可。

sentences.en: Paul Williams developed the eclectic style of the California home and helped shape the look and feel of Los Angeles, just as much as Los Angeles shaped him.
sentences.zh: 保罗·威廉姆斯发展了加州住宅的折衷主义风格，塑造了洛杉矶的风貌，正如洛杉矶塑造了他一样。

sentences.en: A man who could draw magnificent plans in any style, upside down, and better than most of his peers.
sentences.zh: 一个能以任何风格、倒着画出宏伟图纸，并且比大多数同行都优秀的人。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Avery Truffelman, with Shreve Youssef, Delaney Hall, Emmett Fitzgerald, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由艾弗里·特拉费尔曼制作，参与者还有施里夫·优素福、德莱尼·霍尔、埃梅特·菲茨杰拉德以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.zh: 说起我，罗曼·马尔斯，我正在竞选“人民选择奖”最佳播客主持人韦比奖，所以请为我投票。

sentences.en: I would like to win that.
sentences.zh: 我很想赢得这个奖。

sentences.en: I'll link to it in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 我会在节目介绍中附上链接。

sentences.zh: 凯蒂·明格是我们的高级编辑，库尔特·科尔斯坦是数字总监，塔琳·马扎是办公室经理。

sentences.en: The all-original music in this episode was composed by Sean Rial.
sentences.zh: 本期节目中所有原创音乐均由肖恩·里亚尔创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks this week to Taylor Hamilton, Bonnie Boswell, and Bradford Grant.
sentences.zh: 本周特别感谢泰勒·汉密尔顿、邦妮·博斯韦尔和布拉德福德·格兰特。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW in San Francisco and produced on Radio Row in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW电台的一个项目，制作地点位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心美丽的电台街。

sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到本节目并加入相关的讨论。

sentences.zh: 你可以在Twitter上@我（@Roman Mars），也可以@本节目（99pi.org）。

sentences.en: We're on Instagram and Tumblr, too.
sentences.zh: 我们也在Instagram和Tumblr上。

sentences.en: But we released at least two articles about design and architecture every week on our website at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 但我们每周都会在我们的网站99pi.org上发布至少两篇关于设计和建筑的文章。
